newsitem.title: UK: Gulf says offer for Clyde full, generous.
newsitem.headline: Gulf says offer for Clyde full, generous.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources said in a further statement on Thursday that its offer for British oil exploration and production firm Clyde Petroleum was "full and generous", and accused Clyde of making "desperate promises" of future growth in its defence.

"They are massively out of line with Clyde's net asset value. Clyde's board makes desperate promises of future growth. Gulf is offering cash now, not paper promises. 105p in cash represents a full and generous offer," said Gulf senior vice president Dick Auchinleck.
Clyde also ignores its medium and longer term production profile, said Gulf in a statement.
Gulf has extended its 432 million pound hostile bid launched in December last year to January 24.
